headline: Anthropic AI workplace report: human attention becomes the bottleneck
script: AI did the work. Now who checks it? Anthropic's new workplace report says AI agents are producing so much output that human attention has become a bottleneck. Even non-technical staff would need half their week to read everything their agents produce. Employees are building monitoring tools, while human judgment still matters. This is Anthropic studying its own fast-growing company, not proof about every workplace. Faster output still needs someone who can review it.
hook: AI DID THE WORK. WHO CHECKS IT?
